description.value:
It doesn't explode on contact. It keeps the boil going for as long as it takes — through the insult, through the apology nobody offered, through however many years it takes — and only detonates once it's been made to stop mid-tirade. Its followers describe a fury that never quite cools, only waits, and a punishment that always lands exactly when the target thought it was safe.

Its shrines sit in feud towns and standing duel-grounds — places where an old slight never got answered and everyone still remembers whose fault that was. It doesn't ask its cultists to forgive. It asks them to keep score.
